focus.jbig: FOMC Wed + a Mag-7 earnings wall · trade small
focus.jtag: Iran pause cooled oil, but the Fed and four mega-cap prints dominate the week
focus.jnote: Two forces are pulling in opposite directions. Over the weekend the U.S. and Iran announced a pause in hostilities, which drove crude down about $5–6 (WTI ~$85, Brent ~$88) and lifted equity futures. But under the surface a chip/AI-spending scare is hammering semis — AMD and Teradyne fell ~8%, Micron ~5%, and SMH dropped ~4% — after Alphabet’s heavy-capex commentary spooked investors. Sitting on top of all of it: the FOMC decision Wednesday at 2pm ET (no dot plot, rate held at 3.50–3.75% expected) and a wall of mega-cap earnings — MSFT and META Wed, AAPL and AMZN Thu. This is a headline-dense, two-sided week — not a clean premium-selling tape.
focus.notdown: Energy is unwinding, not building — the Iran pause is pulling oil down, so the bullish energy trade from last week has reversed. Airlines & cruise lines (DAL, UAL, CCL) are catching a bid on cheaper fuel, but chasing a one-day relief pop into an FOMC-and-earnings week is exactly the kind of un-anchored move a Sniper skips. Watch-only.
focus.notup: Semiconductors (AMD, MU, TER, SMH) are the clear downside group on AI-spend fear, and the fundamental lean is lower. But selling a bear call into a fast-moving chip rout, two days before both the Fed and the hyperscaler prints (MSFT/META/AMZN) that drive the entire AI-capex story, is a coin-flip on a headline — not an edge. The disciplined move is to wait for the prints to clear.
focus.why: Why YELLOW? The FOMC decision inside 24–72h automatically bars GREEN — the master prompt’s hard rule. Layer on a composite of 52 (WARM), P(≥1% gap) at 38% (above the 35% trigger), a live chip rout, and four mega-cap prints Wed–Thu, and this becomes a week to protect capital, not press it. If you must be on: half size, A-grade only, 7-DTE that expires before Wednesday’s Fed and clears any earnings name. When in doubt, cash is a position.

Earnings are behind it, but the sector catalyst dominates. (not scanner-verified)

risks: FOMC · Wed 7/29 2pm ET — rate expected held at 3.50–3.75%, but no dot plot means all weight falls on Warsh’s tone. With oil-driven inflation fear alive, any hawkish hint (hike risk later in 2026) gaps the tape. Keep every spread clear of Wednesday.

Mag-7 earnings wall — MSFT & META report Wed AMC, AAPL & AMZN Thu AMC. After Alphabet’s capex-driven selloff, one heavy AI-spend guide can drag the entire index. Single-stock gap risk stacked on the macro.
Chip / AI-spend rout — semis are already sliding (AMD/TER −8%, MU −5%, SMH −4%); the group is the market’s pressure point this week and will react violently to the hyperscaler prints.
Oil & the 10-year — the Iran pause pulled WTI to ~$85, but the 10Y is still near ~4.63–4.69%, its highest since Jan ’25. A yield pop back toward 5% compounds pressure on stocks.
Fragile Iran truce — the fighting pause is the reason oil fell and futures rose; any re-escalation headline reverses that in minutes and re-arms the oil tail.

earnings.intro: This is the biggest earnings week of the quarter, and it collides with the Fed. Four of the world’s most valuable companies report inside 48 hours — Microsoft & Meta after the close Wed 7/29, Apple & Amazon after the close Thu 7/30 — the same days as the FOMC decision (Wed 2pm). With Alphabet already punished for heavy capex, the AI-spend question is the swing factor. Keep every spread clear of both the Fed and its name’s print.
